name: casa-das-correntes-separacao
description: App de Separação de Estoque — Casa das Correntes Guanabara

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "blue,green" --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
